verdicts.reason: A breaks the diamond collage: a rectangular photo strip at the right edge runs down to the text zone. The rule line has slid left, away from the headline, and the headline and body float mid-left with the URL stranded far right, leaving the whole right half empty. B keeps the original intact but is just a shrunk portrait copy centred in a wide canvas. Both side margins are wasted, the body copy is small and the vertical URL is barely legible. It is still coherent and on brand, so it is less bad than A.
